incident: support trial withdrawn after user reports launch from lying
candidateStatus: quarantined; not physically accepted; no public trial reactivation
scope: Actual game headless heavy down recovery, synthetic limb-health injury, passive opponent, one deterministic trajectory per condition. No exact large user launch reproduction claimed.

protocol.heavyDown: After legacy3s preparation, call actual knockDown(true); no imposed pose/rotation/impulse. Whether down actually becomes lying is measured rather than assumed.
protocol.injury: Synthetic controller limb-health values .45 single leg / .2 both; actual knockDown(true). No clinical injury or collision reproduction.
protocol.floorRemoval: Single actual fixed harness floor collider removed after legacy preparation; no body reposition/freezing/velocity injection. Opponent only uses harness park.
protocol.uprightDefinition: Game geometry observation: state stand, pelvis>=gait.hNom-GAIT.catchSag, tilt-hunch<=BODY.fallTiltDeg, at least one foot solver point. Not human naturalness/acceptance.
protocol.forceMeaning: directBalancePaths is full driveBalance path explicit forces, not push-only closure unless source supplies a distinct path. Actual bodywise reactions retained. Native joints/motors/contact work not measured; changing foot mass prevents fixed-mass energy closure.
protocol.slipMeaning: Relative velocityAtPoint at actual foot/fixed floor solver world points; solver and impulse contact arrays are separate, no index pairing. Raw impulses receive no 6/7 correction.
protocol.statusMeaning: observed means scene completed, never a human or physically upright success verdict.

protocol.ablationScope: Identical axial2s after knockDown(true); ablation activates at observation2s/world5s. Before that wrapper passes through. Player driveBalance only. noPair intercepts only pelvis/footF/footB addForceAtPoint within driveBalance (archived source only uses these for axial pair). noUpright configures native upright rotation axes3,4,5 position0 stiffness0 damping0 after driveBalance; other targets/PD unchanged. Control removal is diagnosis, not proposed solution.

interpretationWarnings: balanceProbe supportTransfer appliedUpN remains unmodified controller computation in noPair; actual paired force calls are suppressed and ledger records only actually delivered forces. Do not treat that balanceProbe number as applied force in ablated rows.
All four rows share axial2s with passthrough wrappers before switch. Native upright/other motors/contact work is not directly metered by explicit force ledger.
Numerical finite and command exit0 indicate diagnosis completed, not physical acceptance. noUpright and both rows launch violently and final physicallyUprightGameGeometry=false.
One healthy seed is a narrow ablation diagnosis; it does not prove a general cure or exact public-incident cause.

limits: Native motor/contact work is unmetered; central force closure is not energy or stability proof.
Initial seeds7/17 have identical trajectories and are not independent samples.
Readiness gate is rejected diagnosis, never gameplay. It holds both conditions in getup, so absence of repeated falls is not successful recovery.
Ablation132m launch is a modified-control failure with large joint separation, not a reproduction of the shipped trial unchanged.

Readiness hurt raw additional state SHA differs only in two WASM __wbg_ptr addresses at gait legs F/B col.colliderSet.raw; native snapshot and physicalControl are exact; semantic recursive comparison excluding only __wbg_ptr is exact. Original raw files/hashes are retained.
